name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-04) is a major release spanning 238 commits. Key highlights include 'Connect Knowledge' for read-only mounting of Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive/SharePoint, and Dropbox inside rooms; an expanded 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram); per-room agent Channels (renamed from .slack to .channels on disk); and a Telegram remote-control gateway. The release also delivers clean-path routing (replacing hash routes), a 'Manila Arc' borderless redesign, improved auth with PBKDF2 password hashing and rate-limiting, and numerous editor, task, and Windows fixes. See the full release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits and active contributor activity
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, KB_PASSWORD gate, works on mobile and behind reverse proxies

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app now serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron; old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser but the canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful document management with OCR and tagging but is significantly heavier and more complex to self-host than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a full-featured document management system with workflows and permissions, but requires more resources and setup compared to Cabinet's lightweight approach.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automatic document classification and OCR processing but has a steeper learning curve and higher resource footprint than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focused on file browsing across multiple storage backends, but lacks the document-management specific features Cabinet targets.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud offers a comprehensive file and document management suite with cloud sync and collaboration, but is far heavier and more complex than Cabinet's minimal footprint.
